terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: Static single-storey branded retail box on thaikit's shared 8.0 x 4.6 x 7.0 m module, exterior shell only. No interior geometry: glazing is a tinted mostly-opaque pane, not an opening. Nothing moves, so one root pivot and zero sockets is the correct contract. Second build (2026-09-01), authored off the plate's rectified canopy front (8.0 x 4.6), its rectified shell front under the canopy (4.45 x 4.0 to the soffit) and pixel scans (scratch/_ptt/), cross-checked against the Meshy proxy's top-down occupancy and height maps. A filling-station forecourt kiosk: the whole prop is ONE 8 x 7 m roof slab at 4.60 with a 1.0 m deep edge fascia -- navy band 0.82 m carrying the ptt mark on the street face and wrapping the -X edge, red stripe 0.15 m under it, white on the +X and rear edges -- over a ribbed metal canopy deck. The enclosed kiosk (white render, x -1.0..3.4, z -3.44..0.5) stands under the slab's rear-RIGHT, so the canopy is an L: a 3 m strip across the whole front on two square render columns at x +-1.85, plus a 3 m wing down the -X side. Its front is a full-height aluminium sliding-door set beside a window on a 0.7 m riser; a grey membrane roof with a 0.28 m upstand carries one large and two small condensers; a flush white service door sits near the rear of the +X wall.

reasoning: Silhouette is a single rectangular prism -- low geometric complexity.
Richness is REPETITION and PANELLING, not intricate form. The instanced systems collapse the repeated parts into one InstancedMesh each.
Occlusion risk is real: the rear elevation is entirely unseen in the single plate.
Action readiness is minimal: static exterior shell, box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Repetition-dominated facade: without repetitionSystems the mullion and plant sets would each cost a draw call per part and blow maxDrawCalls=12.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: Rear (-Z) elevation is unobserved; authored plain with a white slab edge. Confidence 0.20.
The pumps, apron and forecourt paving are NOT modelled; the apron is the level builder's ground plane.

The plate is projectively INCONSISTENT (the band's edges converge left, the glazing's converge right), so each face was rectified on its own corners and only ratios within a face were trusted. The kiosk's -X wall lands between -0.5 and -1.4 depending on the face used; -1.0 is authored.

The canopy deck ribs are GEOMETRY (one instanced rib on a 0.16 m pitch) rather than a tile, because the plate's hero angle reads them as a raked profile against the light, which a flat tile cannot do.

The plate shows a dim shop interior through the glazing. The rectified shell front is baked onto the glazing as its image (shadows lifted to luma >= 88 for the hole gate), over a dark backdrop slab; nothing behind the glass is modelled -- this prop is an exterior shell.
The ptt flame is a flux/dev droplet-flame thresholded to a white mask, a stylised approximation of the trademark rather than the corporate artwork, set beside 'ptt' in Nimbus Sans Bold Italic.
preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 8.0 x 4.6 x 7.0 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=16000 triangles, <=12 draw calls, <=8 materials, <=16 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot and zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

pivotInventory.name: root
pivotInventory.justification: The ONLY mechanism this prop has. Nothing opens, turns or swings; doors and shutters are authored as fixed geometry, so they get no axis. A named pivot is a promise that a part turns on it.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.

colliderInventory.note: The asset declares collider 'box'. One box proxy.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

coordinateFrame.notes: Origin base-center as the asset declares. The marked fascia and the shopfront face +Z. The kiosk is NOT centred: it occupies x -1.0..3.4 of the -4..4 slab and z -3.44..0.5 of the -3.5..3.5 depth, the band wraps only the -X edge and the service door is on +X, so no mirror plane is declared.

silhouette.description: Not a prism: a thick-edged slab floating on two columns with the enclosed volume under its rear-right, a deep undercut beneath the front strip and the whole -X wing, the low parapet ring and upstand on top, and three condensers breaking the roofline behind the upstand.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -4.00..+4.00 (parapet ring outer faces) = 8.00. y spans 0.00..4.60 = 4.60. z spans -3.50 (rear parapet) ..+3.50 = 7.00. The shell front face is set back to z=+2.50 so anything cantilevering off it lands ON the declared depth rather than overrunning it.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate normalises to w:h:d = 1 : 0.588 : 1.253 against the declared 1 : 0.575 : 0.875 -- height within 3%, 43% deeper. Its top-down maps (scratch/_ptt/top.mjs) agree with the rectified plate on what matters: ONE slab with a parapet ring on every edge, the kiosk under the rear 5.9 of its 9.7 m, two columns near the front edge, the condensers on the kiosk roof. The declared 8.0 x 4.6 x 7.0 m is the kit's shared retail module and wins; the proxy's symmetric column pair (+-2.4 m) is symmetry_mode=auto and the plate's rectified front (2.45 and 6.1 of 8 m) is used instead.

viewEvidence.note: NOT OBSERVED. Authored as plain render under a white slab edge, no openings.
The -X wing is seen only as the band's return in the plate; its 7 m fascia is authored navy with the stripe (the return shows both), the kiosk's -X wall plain.

componentTree.name: Building shell
componentTree.topologyRationale: One continuous render skin over four walls. Splitting it per elevation would cost a draw call per wall for the life of the prop to express one material.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Solid kiosk box under the rear-right of the slab: x -1.0..3.4, y 0..3.72, z -3.44..0.5. SOLID, not a ring -- an exterior shell only ever seen from outside.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: Its top at 3.72 is buried 0.10 m inside the slab body (soffit 3.62); its +X face at 3.40 is 0.45 m inside the slab edge and its rear at -3.44 is 0.08 m inside the rear fascia, so no shell face shares a plane with any slab face.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Flat painted cement render, roughness 0.88, no texture set; the kiosk box x -1.0..3.4, y 0..3.72 (into the slab body), z -3.44..0.5 under the slab's rear-right.

pivot.name: root
pivot.notes: base-center, as the asset declares. A STATIC exterior shell: nothing opens, turns or swings, so one root pivot is the whole mechanism inventory and that is the correct answer, not a gap.

collider.notes: Declared on the asset as box. One convex proxy over the whole envelope; a level builder collides with the building, not with its canopy plates.

componentTree.name: Roof deck
componentTree.topologyRationale: A flat deck plane. Its own component only because the membrane is a visibly different value from the wall render, and this prop is seen from above in every hero shot.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Membrane over the kiosk footprint, the canopy L 2 cm lower so the two never share a top plane, and the dark backdrop slab 3 cm inside the shell face.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: Membrane top 4.42, canopy deck top 4.40, ring bottom 4.30 buried in both; the backdrop slab at z 0.465..0.475 behind the 0.49 pane back.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Membrane over the kiosk (tone #6F757C) at deck 4.30..4.42, the ribbed canopy deck over the L (tone #B8BBBD) at 4.30..4.40, and the dark backdrop slab behind the glazing -- one white-based material, one submission, vertex tones.

actionProfile.notes: Rigidly parented to the root. NO pivot and NO socket, deliberately: this part does not move and nothing attaches to it.

componentTree.name: Roof slab, parapet ring, upstands, columns and door leaf
componentTree.topologyRationale: Every white render part that is not the kiosk box shares one material, so it is one merged component and one draw call: the slab is the prop's largest surface and its columns are what carry it.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: ONE 8 x 7 slab: body x -3.90..3.86, z -3.43..3.40, y 3.62..4.30 behind the fascias; white fascia runs 3.62..4.60 on +X (x 3.85..3.99) and the rear (z -3.50..-3.36); ring runs 4.30..4.60 on the front and -X behind the navy boards; upstands 4.30..4.58 along the kiosk's front and -X roof edges; 0.42 m columns at x +-1.85, z 2.72 into the body; the door leaf 3 cm proud of the +X wall.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: The body's +X face at 3.86 sits inside the +X run (3.85..3.99); its -X face at -3.90 is inside the -X navy board (-4.00..-3.88); its front at 3.40 inside the front board (3.38..3.50); its soffit at 3.62 is 1 cm below the stripe's bottom (3.63). The +X run stops at x 3.99 so the stripe wrap can own x 4.00; the rear run stops at x 3.86 so it shares no +X plane with the +X run. Upstand tops at 4.58 under the ring's 4.60.
geometryDescriptor.mergeNote: Merged multi-box cluster, one BufferGeometry, one draw call.

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: The SAME render as the kiosk: the slab body (soffit 3.62 to deck 4.30), the parapet ring 4.30..4.60 with the +X and rear edges white for the slab's full 1.0 m depth, the 0.28 m upstands on the deck, the two columns and the service door leaf -- one material, one submission.

actionProfile.notes: Rigidly parented to the root. NO pivot and NO socket, deliberately: this part does not move and nothing attaches to it.

componentTree.name: Brand fascia panel
componentTree.topologyRationale: BoxGeometry lays its faces out as a known slice of the uv attribute, so one board names the face carrying the mark while the return samples a joints-and-rust slice of the same atlas. One material, one draw call.

geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: The -X board ends at z 3.38, the front board's back face, so the two touch and never overlap -- run to the same depth the front board's canvas smeared through the corner. Its outer face at -4.00 is 6.5 cm outside the red stripe's -X run (-3.995) below it.

componentTree.name: Shopfront framing and door bay
componentTree.topologyRationale: Every one of these parts is the same metal. Folding them into one component is the draw-call lever chosen in the BLOCKOUT -- a part split for authoring convenience cannot be merged afterwards once pivots hang off it.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Perimeter frame, transom, kick rail, door jambs and door header MERGED into one component.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: Frame front face stands proud of both the glazing and the mullions. The frame OVERLAPS the glazing it holds rather than meeting its edge, which is the rule that stops a frame putting four coincident reveal faces in the model.
geometryDescriptor.mergeNote: Merged multi-box cluster, one BufferGeometry, one draw call.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-wall (PBR confidence 0.767) at #D9D9D6; authored #E2E2DF because a side face renders at ~0.76 of the authored value under the harness and the render tile only darkens. Streaks and float marks are a drawn post-construction tile in multiplier space.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

buildPasses.goal: Refine shape, deformation, bevels, tapers, curves, asymmetry, and visible local geometry.

buildPasses.goal: Match material color, roughness, bump, and local variation.
acceptance: Reference-derived albedo palette records dominant, secondary, and accent colors per visible material.

Generated preview uses procedural albedo/roughness/bump texture or vertex color variation instead of one flat color.
Generated preview uses independent PBR maps at 1024px or higher for the quality-first tier.
If source pixels are available, referencePbr extraction passed at confidence >= 0.7 or the pass is stopped/requesting better references.
Macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands are visible at the intended review distance without obvious tiling.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Add procedural surface locality such as normal/bump/displacement, AO, dirt, stains, chips, grain, moss, scratches, and wear.
acceptance: Every required material feature group has local overrides or surfaceDetail tied to evidenceRefs.

AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make material and form readable under neutral turntable lighting plus optional reference lighting.
acceptance: lightingFromPhoto identifies key light direction/color/intensity, fill light, rim or environment light, and ambient color.

AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make the model ready for future animation, transformation, physics, or destruction.
acceptance: Macro and movable meso components have stable pivot nodes.

AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the hero2x class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Three repetition systems collapse 217 discrete parts into 3 submissions. Slab, ring, upstands, columns and door leaf fold into the parapet; both navy boards into the fascia; the stripe's three runs into one component; the door fittings and pipe into a fifth. Eleven of twelve.

materials.note: wall covers the kiosk, slab, ring, upstands, columns and door leaf; deck covers the membrane, the canopy deck, the backdrop slab and the ribs (vertex/instance tones on a white base); frame covers the framing and mullions; galv the plant and fittings. Seven of eight.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: Triangles are NOT the binding constraint on this prop -- draw calls are. The headroom is deliberately spent on silhouette quality (chamfers, cowl segments, shutter ribs) and must not be read as room to split components, which would spend the axis that is actually scarce.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: box, cylinder and merged-box clusters only. No organic surfaces exist on this subject.
Three InstancedMesh systems carry 217 of the ~240 discrete parts.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.

Every material is declared textureless. The brand fascia receives its wordmark as a generated canvas assigned AFTER material construction -- the documented route for a printed brand fascia, unaffected by the declaration.

risks.description: The generated plate is not a consistent perspective, so the kiosk's -X wall and the columns' setback carry +-0.4 m of uncertainty.
risks.mitigation: Each face rectified on its own corners; the proxy's top-down maps used as the second reading; both recorded in assumptions.

risks.description: Rear and most of the -X wing are not in the single plate; authored plain.
The large condenser reaches 5.30 m against the declared 4.60.
risks.mitigation: On plant only; the plate shows the unit standing a full casing height above the parapet the same way.

risks.description: The flame glyph is a generated droplet mask, not the corporate artwork.
risks.mitigation: Recorded in assumptions and on the material override.
